Imagine tipping Lil Baby 😭

Lil Baby, born Dominique Armani Jones, is an American rapper and songwriter who rose to massive mainstream fame out of Atlanta’s dominant trap music scene. He first gained widespread attention in 2017 with his mixtape *Too Hard* and hit single “Freestyle,” before solidifying his position as one of hip-hop’s biggest stars with his 2020 chart-topping album *My Turn* and the acclaimed protest anthem “The Bigger Picture.” Known for his fast-paced melodic flow, reflective lyrics about his past, and frequent collaborations with artists like Drake and Gunna, he has earned multiple Grammy nominations and commercial certifications throughout his career.
